defect.cause: updateEntity clamps positive cooldown overshoot to zero and resets the full cooldown after every hit. For PON at 0.26-second simulation steps, 0.9-second cooldown repeats at four ticks (1.04 seconds), losing 0.14 seconds per hit.
defect.reproduction: Execute the canonical complete server via tests/roblox_server_harness.lua, buy one PON, suppress later purchases, and observe the first JUNK HealthBar changes. The third hit occurs eight ticks after the first in the pinned pre-fix server, instead of seven with fractional carry.
defect.scope: Deterministic Lua whole-server harness; Roblox engine timing and player experience not measured.

fix: Keep cooldown nonnegative while idle; when a positive cooldown expires during a step, carry only that step's negative remainder into the next cooldown. Preserve unit stats, initial ready-to-fire state and all other behavior.
character_impact: PON and other combatants preserve fractional cooldown timing under non-divisor Heartbeat steps; no unit damage, HP, speed, prices, visuals or factory economy changed.

tests.old_source_negative_control: CI pinned pre-fix canonical server if available

evidence.main_qa_note: QA success on gameplay-identical 550afd73 ancestor; current HEAD is status-only descendant

next_action: Verify exact-head CI including new native whole-server regression and pinned old-source negative control; if successful, hand draft PR to independent REVIEWER. Do not self-merge.
